name: Should I choose pre-primed or unfinished window casing?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose pre-primed or unfinished window casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between pre-primed and unfinished window casing depends on your project goals and budget. Pre-primed casing comes with a factory-applied primer, saving you a step during installation and potentially reducing labor time for painting. Unfinished casing offers more flexibility if you want a custom stain or a very specific paint finish, but it requires more preparation and labor on-site. Pre-primed is often preferred for painted finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose pre-primed casing for convenience and reduced painting labor, or unfinished for custom stains or specific paint finishes requiring more prep.
